careerDirection.directionDescription: Cloud-native software development involves building applications designed from the ground up for cloud deployment — microservices, serverless functions, and containerised workloads. Backend developers build cloud-hosted application logic; API developers build the integration layers between services; Python developers build scripting and automation tools for cloud environments. BCA Cloud Computing graduates who combine cloud architecture knowledge with programming skills are valuable in cloud-native development teams.

careerDirection.directionDescription: Cloud automation and emerging technology involves using orchestration tools, RPA, and AI services to automate infrastructure and business workflows. RPA developers build automation using cloud-hosted RPA platforms; automation engineers design cloud-based robotic process workflows; emerging technology analysts evaluate new cloud AI and ML services for business adoption. BCA Cloud Computing graduates with automation scripting and cloud AI service knowledge can enter these fast-growing roles.

careerDirection.directionDescription: Cloud IT support and operations involves managing cloud-hosted business applications, resolving user issues, and maintaining service availability. IT service desk analysts troubleshoot cloud application issues; ERP consultants configure and support cloud-based ERP systems; IT consultants advise organisations on cloud migration decisions. BCA Cloud Computing graduates who prefer support and advisory roles over engineering can access these positions in managed service companies and cloud solution providers.
